'''Gennady Andreyevich Mesyats''' ({{langx|ru|Геннадий Андреевич Месяц}}, born 29 February 1936) is a Soviet and Russian physicist, founder of several scientific schools — high-current electronics and pulse electrophysics, one of the acknowledged world leaders in these areas.<ref name="a">{{cite book|url=https://www.morebooks.de/store/gb/book/gennady-mesyats/isbn/978-620-1-23496-3|title=Gennady Mesyats|work=Kemerovo, Lebedev Physical Institute, IEEE Marie Sklodowska-Curie Award, Russia|date=2012-06-24|accessdate=20 August 2018|isbn=9786201234963|publisher=Loc}}</ref><ref name="hdoctors">{{cite web|url=https://www.en.tsu.ru/about/honorary_doctors.php|title=Honorary Doctors|date=|accessdate=20 August 2018}}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

He has been a vice-president of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] since 1987 and a director of the [[Lebedev Physical Institute]] since 2004. In 2012, he was elected as an international member of [[National Academy of Engineering]] "for development and application of pulsed power technology."<ref>{{cite web |title=Professor Gennady Andreevich Mesyats |url=https://www.nae.edu/56169/Professor-Gennady-Andreevich-Mesyats |website=nae.edu |publisher=[[National Academy of Engineering]] |access-date=October 18, 2026}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* [[Order "For Merit to the Fatherland"]], 1st class (2024)
* Order "For Merit to the Fatherland", 2nd class (2006)
* Order "For Merit to the Fatherland", 3rd class (1999)
* Order "For Merit to the Fatherland", 4th class (1996)
* [[Lenin Komsomol Prize]] (1968)
* [[Jubilee Medal "In Commemoration of the 100th Anniversary of the Birth of Vladimir Ilyich Lenin"]] (1970)
* [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour]] (1971)
* [[USSR State Prize]] (1978)
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (1981)
* [[Order of Lenin]] (1986)
* [[Dyke Award]] (1990)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://isdeiv.lbl.gov/awards.html|title=Dyke Awards|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160309041152/http://isdeiv.lbl.gov/awards.html|archivedate=9 March 2016|website=isdeiv.lbl.gov}}</ref>
* [[State Prize of the Russian Federation|State Prize of the Russian Federation for Science and Technology]] (1998)
* [[Demidov Prize]] (2002)
* [[Global Energy Prize]] (2003)
* [[Legion of Honour]] (2008)
* [[Order of Honour (Russia)|Order of Honour]] (2011)
* [[IEEE Marie Sklodowska-Curie Award]] (2012)
* [[Order of Alexander Nevsky]] (2021)
